scope: Stage B slice 2: adapt calculations and virtual inputs to the shared observation verdict while preserving constants and virtual-input Epoch/TTL semantics

observation.allow_no_expiry: Only non-observation sources or explicit simulated trials may omit expiry; ordinary observation without valid_until remains expiry_unconfigured
observation.direct_expiry: A direct expires_at is valid even when MaxAge is zero
observation.state: state.Value.ExpiresAt is copied from the same verdict

calculation.freshness: calculation.Freshness and Result.Freshness adapt sample quality and valid_until
calculation.boundary: now == valid_until is usable; only now > valid_until becomes expired
calculation.sources: Only Source=observation requires SourceTime; configuration, manual, simulation and calculation use their existing time evidence
calculation.retention: Previous good results remain available as non-current retained values after expiry

virtual_inputs.configuration: Configuration constants remain good without expires_at
virtual_inputs.timed: bad maps to invalid, stale to stale, uninitialized to unknown; Epoch/TTL and restart verification are unchanged
virtual_inputs.runtime: Calculation runtime uses state.ExpiresAt and the virtual-input verdict instead of duplicating expiry logic

verification.runtime: ConfigurationConstantAndTimedVirtualFreshness proves an initial 100 kW result becomes stale and retains the previous 100 kW result
verification.restart: VirtualInputPersistenceRestartCopyAndRollback additionally proves a restarted calculation cannot become good while its input is pending_verification
verification.browser: Calculation page shows 常量计算=200 kW usable, 定时计算=原始输入已过期, and 历史保留值（非当前）：100 kW
verification.acceptance_fixes: Direct expires_at with MaxAge=0 and non-observation SourceTime handling were reproduced, fixed and retested
verification.review: Independent review found an over-broad zero-expiry exemption; Freshness now exempts only non-observation sources or explicit simulations, with a failing-then-passing ordinary-observation regression and restart runtime coverage
verification.cleanup: Temporary inputs/calculations deleted and UI server stopped

remaining_stage_b: Unify channel link-health verdicts for delivery, preflight, allocator and alarm monitoring
limits: No link-health changes, formula changes or virtual-input public-shape changes
No production device connection or physical write
